normalization: NFKC, whitespace collapse, LF, recursively sorted canonical JSON, integer-valued floats canonicalized to integers; no tokenization. Component hashes strip identifying cells/metadata; score-map hashes include task values and settings. Full raw source rows retained. Null distinct from missing.
split: Connected components under model alias, raw normalized component and score-map content identities; deterministic sha256 split-v1-38271, modulo3=0 search, otherwise final. All repeated revisions and selected results grouped with their contents row.
license_assessment: Public unauthenticated leaderboard score facts are used for noncommercial reproducible research with attribution. No separate score-data license identified; code/model licenses do not transfer. Derived raw-row extracts, not full mirrors; redistribution permission remains uncertain and must be reviewed before public release.
sensitivity_limit: Selected 90 deterministic lexicographically spaced models, latest available result per model at pinned results commit. Keep only exact model-sha matches and complete 24-BBH panels. Contents and results are distinct runs; no claim of equal evaluation settings or score equality. Sensitivity is separately reported, not scored or merged into primary six-task scores.
limitations: No actual training; coordinate-support uplift is a conditional model, not contamination causality or monetary investment.
No scientific performance minimum is delegated; eligibility checks integrity/validity only.
Trusted median/trimmed lower bounds may be conservative; exact six-coordinate audits do not prove full-panel optimality.
No forbidden literature was searched or accessed; named score assets and official conference formatting only.

HELM observed mean in-context counts vary slightly on a few runs; raw denominators, training counts and run specs are retained. Public snapshot scores are not assumed to come from perfectly homogeneous model evaluation conditions.

protocol_policy.episodes: Case order HELM then OpenLLM, ordinary/constant/copy/permutation, seeds in declared order, then sole first-episode reset replay. Every reset, including the terminal replay, belongs to the complete global contract reset sequence across proxies, connections and process restarts. Replay has statistical weight zero and remains a required validity gate.
controls: joint nonidentity value-changing column permutation: matched exact-projection feasibility, verified bound and returned cost invariant
reset replay: same logical plans/status/bounds from first seed
protocol_policy.validity: Honest bounded intervals are allowed, including on small audits; never require a comparative search margin. Independently verified claims and matched control consistency gate correctness, not minimum effort performance.
protocol_policy.aggregation: Equal alpha, rule, target, statistical seed; cases 0.7/0.1/0.1/0.1; families 0.5/0.5. Auxiliary decisions unscored validity/sensitivity. Replay weight zero. Failed episode retains utility/feasibility/control=0 and effort/gap=1.
protocol_policy.uncertainty: 200 paired cluster-bootstrap resamples, RNG48271, per-family/seed/rule/alpha candidate-minus-baseline effort, percentile95. Conditional on fixed rival pools and snapshots; not population/dataset-independent confidence or a significance gate.
protocol_policy.calibration: No productive-time minimum or comparative threshold delegated by task.md; no artificial floor imposed. Productive baseline loops separately measured, excluding imports/reset/startup/cleanup/output.
protocol_policy.matched_method_reservations: All four methods receive 5 seconds per 12 targets (216 primary-plus-auxiliary decisions), hence search 5 seconds and final 10 seconds; smoke 1 second. Existing wall/CPU ceilings, reference/scoring allowances, cleanup and reset reserves are unchanged. Joint conservative requirements: search 485.9/900 seconds, final 1199.5/1800 seconds, smoke 110.3/120 seconds. Candidate run.work_seconds supplies the positive finite remaining method seconds after uploads; all transport, solve, reads and release share this reservation. It carries no plane or seed mapping.

split_attestation: Draft-time paired raw-content audit found zero shared normalized hashes across the frozen roots, also grouping aliases and component ancestry. Counterpart membership/content is sealed; only its SHA256 commitment is present here. Wrapper binds this attestation and own raw rows by artifact hashes.
